phrases.en: Is this your pen?
phrases.zh: 这是你的笔吗？

phrases.en: Yes, it is.
phrases.zh: 是的，这是我的。

phrases.en: Thank you.
phrases.zh: 谢谢你。

phrases.en: This is not my coat.
phrases.zh: 这不是我的外套。

phrases.en: Is this your umbrella?
phrases.zh: 这是你的伞吗？

phrases.en: No, it isn't.
phrases.zh: 不，这不是我的。

phrases.en: This is Anna.
phrases.zh: 这是安娜。

phrases.en: She is Chinese.
phrases.zh: 她是中国人。

phrases.en: Nice to meet you, Anna.
phrases.zh: 很高兴认识你，安娜。

phrases.en: What is your name?
phrases.zh: 你叫什么名字？

phrases.en: I am Chinese.
phrases.zh: 我是中国人。

phrases.en: Are you a student?
phrases.zh: 你是学生吗？

phrases.en: How are you today?
phrases.zh: 你今天怎么样？

phrases.en: I am fine, thank you.
phrases.zh: 我很好，谢谢。

phrases.en: Is your mother well?
phrases.zh: 你妈妈身体好吗？

phrases.en: Whose shirt is this?
phrases.zh: 这是谁的衬衫？

phrases.en: It is my father's shirt.
phrases.zh: 这是我爸爸的衬衫。

phrases.en: Her coat is here.
phrases.zh: 她的外套在这里。

phrases.en: What colour is your dress?
phrases.zh: 你的连衣裙是什么颜色？

phrases.en: My dress is blue.
phrases.zh: 我的连衣裙是蓝色的。

phrases.en: Is your sister's coat green?
phrases.zh: 你姐姐的外套是绿色的吗？

phrases.en: We are Chinese.
phrases.zh: 我们是中国人。

phrases.en: These are our passports.
phrases.zh: 这些是我们的护照。

phrases.en: Are these your bags?
phrases.zh: 这些是你们的包吗？

phrases.en: These are my friends.
phrases.zh: 这些是我的朋友。

phrases.en: They are teachers.
phrases.zh: 他们是老师。

phrases.en: Their names are Anna and Ben.
phrases.zh: 他们叫安娜和本。

phrases.en: What's the matter?
phrases.zh: 怎么了？

phrases.en: We are tired and thirsty.
phrases.zh: 我们又累又渴。

phrases.en: Are you all right now?
phrases.zh: 你们现在好些了吗？

phrases.en: Give me a book, please.
phrases.zh: 请递给我一本书。

phrases.en: Which one?
phrases.zh: 哪一本？

phrases.en: The blue one, please.
phrases.zh: 请给我蓝色的那一本。

phrases.en: Give me some cups, please.
phrases.zh: 请递给我几个杯子。

phrases.en: Which ones?
phrases.zh: 哪几个？

phrases.en: The ones on the table.
phrases.zh: 桌子上的那几个。

phrases.en: There is a cup on the table.
phrases.zh: 桌上有一个杯子。

phrases.en: The cup is white.
phrases.zh: 这个杯子是白色的。

phrases.en: There is a chair near the door.
phrases.zh: 门旁边有一把椅子。

phrases.en: There are two chairs in the room.
phrases.zh: 房间里有两把椅子。

phrases.en: Where are the books?
phrases.zh: 书在哪里？

phrases.en: They are on the table.
phrases.zh: 它们在桌子上。

phrases.en: Open the window, please.
phrases.zh: 请打开窗户。

phrases.en: Put the books on the shelf.
phrases.zh: 把书放到架子上。

phrases.en: Then clean the table.
phrases.zh: 然后擦桌子。

phrases.en: Where is your mother?
phrases.zh: 你妈妈在哪里？

phrases.en: She is in the kitchen.
phrases.zh: 她在厨房里。

phrases.en: She is making tea.
phrases.zh: 她正在沏茶。

phrases.en: It is a fine day.
phrases.zh: 今天天气很好。

phrases.en: The children are playing in the park.
phrases.zh: 孩子们正在公园里玩。

phrases.en: What are those men doing?
phrases.zh: 那些男士正在做什么？

phrases.en: Our school is near the river.
phrases.zh: 我们的学校在河附近。

phrases.en: There are some shops in our village.
phrases.zh: 我们村里有几家商店。

phrases.en: The children are walking across the bridge.
phrases.zh: 孩子们正在走过桥。

phrases.en: I am making a bookcase.
phrases.zh: 我正在做一个书架。

phrases.en: I am going to paint it white.
phrases.zh: 我准备把它漆成白色。

phrases.en: What are you going to do next?
phrases.zh: 你接下来准备做什么？

phrases.en: I am going to put this box on the table.
phrases.zh: 我准备把这个箱子放到桌上。

phrases.en: Don't drop it.
phrases.zh: 别把它掉到地上。

phrases.en: Give me that bag, please.
phrases.zh: 请把那个包递给我。

phrases.en: Is there any water in your bag?
phrases.zh: 你的包里有水吗？

phrases.en: There is some water in this bottle.
phrases.zh: 这个瓶子里有一些水。

phrases.en: There isn't any bread.
phrases.zh: 没有面包了。

phrases.en: Can you make some tea, please?
phrases.zh: 你能沏点茶吗？

phrases.en: Is there any milk?
phrases.zh: 有牛奶吗？

phrases.en: Are there any clean cups?
phrases.zh: 有干净的杯子吗？

phrases.en: Can you type this letter?
phrases.zh: 你会打这封信吗？

phrases.en: I can type, but I can't cook.
phrases.zh: 我会打字，但不会做饭。

phrases.en: What can you do?
phrases.zh: 你会做什么？

phrases.en: Do you want some coffee?
phrases.zh: 你想喝点咖啡吗？

phrases.en: I like tea, but I don't like coffee.
phrases.zh: 我喜欢茶，但不喜欢咖啡。

phrases.en: Do you want any milk in your tea?
phrases.zh: 你的茶里要加牛奶吗？

phrases.en: I like chicken.
phrases.zh: 我喜欢吃鸡肉。

phrases.en: My mother likes fish.
phrases.zh: 我妈妈喜欢吃鱼。

phrases.en: My father doesn't like beef.
phrases.zh: 我爸爸不喜欢吃牛肉。

phrases.en: Where do you come from?
phrases.zh: 你来自哪里？

phrases.en: It is warm here in spring.
phrases.zh: 这里春天很暖和。

phrases.en: It rains a lot in summer.
phrases.zh: 这里夏天经常下雨。

phrases.en: It is usually hot here in July.
phrases.zh: 这里七月通常很热。

phrases.en: It sometimes rains in the afternoon.
phrases.zh: 下午有时会下雨。

phrases.en: It is often cold in winter.
phrases.zh: 冬天经常很冷。

phrases.en: I go to work at eight every morning.
phrases.zh: 我每天早上八点去上班。

phrases.en: My father reads the newspaper after breakfast.
phrases.zh: 我爸爸早饭后看报纸。

phrases.en: We watch television in the evening.
phrases.zh: 我们晚上看电视。

phrases.en: I usually go to work by bus.
phrases.zh: 我通常坐公交车上班。

phrases.en: Today I am walking to work.
phrases.zh: 今天我正在步行去上班。

phrases.en: My father usually reads, but now he is cooking.
phrases.zh: 我爸爸通常看书，但现在正在做饭。

phrases.en: Do you have any eggs?
phrases.zh: 你们有鸡蛋吗？

phrases.en: I want six eggs and some bread.
phrases.zh: 我要六个鸡蛋和一些面包。

phrases.en: That's all, thank you.
phrases.zh: 就这些，谢谢。

phrases.en: I don't feel well.
phrases.zh: 我感觉不舒服。

phrases.en: I have a headache.
phrases.zh: 我头疼。

phrases.en: Can I see the doctor today?
phrases.zh: 我今天能看医生吗？

phrases.en: You must keep the room clean.
phrases.zh: 你必须保持房间整洁。

phrases.en: You mustn't eat in the library.
phrases.zh: 你不能在图书馆吃东西。

phrases.en: Don't make a noise, please.
phrases.zh: 请不要制造噪声。

phrases.en: Can I go out this evening?
phrases.zh: 我今晚可以出去吗？

phrases.en: You must be home at ten o'clock.
phrases.zh: 你必须十点到家。

phrases.en: Enjoy yourself.
phrases.zh: 玩得开心。

phrases.en: Where were you on Saturday?
phrases.zh: 你星期六在哪里？

phrases.en: I was at home in the morning.
phrases.zh: 我上午在家。

phrases.en: We were at the park in the afternoon.
phrases.zh: 我们下午在公园。

phrases.en: There was a race in our town yesterday.
phrases.zh: 昨天我们镇上有一场比赛。

phrases.en: There were a lot of people there.
phrases.zh: 那里有很多人。

phrases.en: The race was very exciting.
phrases.zh: 比赛非常精彩。

phrases.en: I called my friend yesterday.
phrases.zh: 我昨天给朋友打了电话。

phrases.en: Did you call him in the morning?
phrases.zh: 你上午给他打的电话吗？

phrases.en: No, I called him after lunch.
phrases.zh: 不是，我午饭后给他打的电话。

phrases.en: I asked a woman the way to the station.
phrases.zh: 我向一位女士询问去车站的路。

phrases.en: She spoke slowly.
phrases.zh: 她说得很慢。

phrases.en: I thanked her and walked to the station.
phrases.zh: 我向她道谢，然后步行去车站。

phrases.en: I bought these shoes last month.
phrases.zh: 我上个月买了这双鞋。

phrases.en: They were too small for me.
phrases.zh: 它们对我来说太小了。

phrases.en: Can I try this pair, please?
phrases.zh: 我可以试一下这双吗？

phrases.en: Can I see the dentist this afternoon?
phrases.zh: 我今天下午能看牙医吗？

phrases.en: Isn't there an appointment at three?
phrases.zh: 三点不是有一个预约时间吗？

phrases.en: I called yesterday morning.
phrases.zh: 我昨天上午打过电话。

phrases.en: We haven't got any bread.
phrases.zh: 我们没有面包了。

phrases.en: Have we got any milk?
phrases.zh: 我们还有牛奶吗？

phrases.en: I must go to the shop to get some.
phrases.zh: 我得去商店买一些。

phrases.en: I had breakfast at seven yesterday.
phrases.zh: 我昨天七点吃的早饭。

phrases.en: We had lunch at a restaurant.
phrases.zh: 我们在一家餐馆吃了午饭。

phrases.en: What are we going to have for dinner?
phrases.zh: 我们晚饭准备吃什么？

phrases.en: I have had breakfast.
phrases.zh: 我已经吃过早饭了。

phrases.en: Have you packed your bag?
phrases.zh: 你收拾好包了吗？

phrases.en: We have cleaned the car.
phrases.zh: 我们已经把车洗好了。

phrases.en: Have you been to Beijing?
phrases.zh: 你去过北京吗？

phrases.en: I have been there twice.
phrases.zh: 我去过那里两次。

phrases.en: I went there with my family last year.
phrases.zh: 我去年和家人一起去的。

phrases.en: Have you repaired my bike yet?
phrases.zh: 你修好我的自行车了吗？

phrases.en: I have already repaired it.
phrases.zh: 我已经修好了。

phrases.en: I haven't tried it yet.
phrases.zh: 我还没试骑。

phrases.en: How long have you lived here?
phrases.zh: 你在这里住了多久？

phrases.en: I have lived here for three years.
phrases.zh: 我在这里住了三年。

phrases.en: I moved here in 2023.
phrases.zh: 我在二〇二三年搬来这里。

phrases.en: I will call you tomorrow.
phrases.zh: 我明天会给你打电话。

phrases.en: When will you arrive?
phrases.zh: 你什么时候到？

phrases.en: I will meet you at the station at six.
phrases.zh: 我会六点在车站接你。

phrases.en: Our new neighbour moved here last week.
phrases.zh: 我们的新邻居上周搬来了。

phrases.en: He has lived in Shanghai before.
phrases.zh: 他以前在上海住过。

phrases.en: He will visit us on Sunday.
phrases.zh: 他星期日会来我们家。

phrases.en: I'd like two tickets to London, please.
phrases.zh: 我想要两张去伦敦的票。

phrases.en: What time will the train leave?
phrases.zh: 火车几点出发？

phrases.en: We had better hurry.
phrases.zh: 我们最好快一点。

phrases.en: This small blue bag is mine.
phrases.zh: 这个蓝色小包是我的。

phrases.en: Is that suitcase yours?
phrases.zh: 那个行李箱是你的吗？

phrases.en: Mine has a red label.
phrases.zh: 我的行李箱有一个红色标签。

phrases.en: Anna says that she is tired.
phrases.zh: 安娜说她累了。

phrases.en: She says that she wants some water.
phrases.zh: 她说她想喝点水。

phrases.en: Ben says that he can help her.
phrases.zh: 本说他可以帮她。

phrases.en: My brother says that he likes his new job.
phrases.zh: 我哥哥说他喜欢新工作。

phrases.en: He says that he arrived on Monday.
phrases.zh: 他说他星期一到的。

phrases.en: He says that he will come home next month.
phrases.zh: 他说他下个月会回家。

phrases.en: This question is too difficult for me.
phrases.zh: 这道题对我来说太难了。

phrases.en: I couldn't answer it yesterday.
phrases.zh: 我昨天没能回答出来。

phrases.en: I have enough time to try again.
phrases.zh: 我有足够的时间再试一次。

phrases.en: I want you to check this letter.
phrases.zh: 我想让你检查这封信。

phrases.en: Please tell Ben to call me.
phrases.zh: 请告诉本给我打电话。

phrases.en: Tell him not to send it yet.
phrases.zh: 告诉他暂时不要寄出去。

phrases.en: This shirt is smaller than that one.
phrases.zh: 这件衬衫比那件小。

phrases.en: The blue one is the largest.
phrases.zh: 蓝色的那件最大。

phrases.en: Can I try a larger size?
phrases.zh: 我可以试一个更大的尺码吗？

phrases.en: We haven't got much milk.
phrases.zh: 我们没有多少牛奶了。

phrases.en: There are fewer eggs than yesterday.
phrases.zh: 鸡蛋比昨天少了。

phrases.en: We need more bread and less sugar.
phrases.zh: 我们需要多一些面包、少一些糖。

phrases.en: This phone is more expensive than that one.
phrases.zh: 这部手机比那部贵。

phrases.en: The black one is not as expensive as the white one.
phrases.zh: 黑色的那部没有白色的贵。

phrases.en: This is the most useful one for me.
phrases.zh: 这部对我来说最实用。

phrases.en: Have you got any change?
phrases.zh: 你有零钱吗？

phrases.en: I'm sorry, I've got none.
phrases.zh: 抱歉，我一点也没有。

phrases.en: I haven't got any either.
phrases.zh: 我也没有。

phrases.en: Is there anyone in the office?
phrases.zh: 办公室里有人吗？

phrases.en: No one is here.
phrases.zh: 这里没有人。

phrases.en: Someone has left a bag on the chair.
phrases.zh: 有人把一个包留在椅子上了。

phrases.en: I was cooking when the phone rang.
phrases.zh: 电话响时，我正在做饭。

phrases.en: My brother was reading in his room.
phrases.zh: 我弟弟当时正在房间里看书。

phrases.en: While I was answering the phone, the soup boiled over.
phrases.zh: 我接电话时，汤溢出来了。

phrases.en: I had finished my work before I went out.
phrases.zh: 我出去前已经完成了工作。

phrases.en: When I reached the station, the train had left.
phrases.zh: 我到车站时，火车已经开走了。

phrases.en: I went home after I had called my friend.
phrases.zh: 我给朋友打过电话后就回家了。

phrases.en: The woman who is wearing a red coat is my teacher.
phrases.zh: 穿红色外套的那位女士是我的老师。

phrases.en: This is the book that I bought yesterday.
phrases.zh: 这就是我昨天买的书。

phrases.en: Where is the bag which was on the chair?
phrases.zh: 原来在椅子上的那个包在哪里？

phrases.en: This is the friend who travelled with me.
phrases.zh: 这是和我一起旅行的朋友。

phrases.en: The bridge that we visited was very old.
phrases.zh: 我们参观的那座桥很古老。

phrases.en: What a beautiful place!
phrases.zh: 多么美丽的地方啊！

phrases.en: I had to take a taxi yesterday.
phrases.zh: 我昨天不得不坐出租车。

phrases.en: We will have to leave before seven tomorrow.
phrases.zh: 我们明天得在七点前出发。

phrases.en: You don't need to buy a ticket today.
phrases.zh: 你今天不用买票。

phrases.en: The lights are on, so someone must be at home.
phrases.zh: 灯亮着，所以肯定有人在家。

phrases.en: That can't be Ben; he is in London.
phrases.zh: 那不可能是本，他在伦敦。

phrases.en: You must be tired after that long walk.
phrases.zh: 走了那么远，你肯定累了。

phrases.en: The shop was closed, so the owner must have been away.
phrases.zh: 店关着，所以店主当时肯定不在。

phrases.en: Anna can't have been there; she was at work.
phrases.zh: 安娜当时不可能在那里，她在上班。

phrases.en: It must have been very cold last night.
phrases.zh: 昨晚肯定很冷。

phrases.en: I may go to the park on Sunday.
phrases.zh: 我星期日可能去公园。

phrases.en: Ben may be at the station now.
phrases.zh: 本现在可能在车站。

phrases.en: He may have been busy yesterday.
phrases.zh: 他昨天可能很忙。

phrases.en: Anna said that she was busy.
phrases.zh: 安娜说她当时很忙。

phrases.en: She told me that she would call the next day.
phrases.zh: 她告诉我她第二天会打电话。

phrases.en: Ben said that he had lost his keys.
phrases.zh: 本说他丢了钥匙。

phrases.en: Ben said that he had finished the work.
phrases.zh: 本说他已经完成了工作。

phrases.en: He said that he would send it the next morning.
phrases.zh: 他说他第二天早上会把它发出去。

phrases.en: He has just told me that it is ready.
phrases.zh: 他刚刚告诉我东西已经准备好了。

phrases.en: If it is sunny, we will go to the park.
phrases.zh: 如果天气晴朗，我们就去公园。

phrases.en: If it rains, we will stay at home.
phrases.zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家。

phrases.en: I will call you if our plans change.
phrases.zh: 如果我们的计划变了，我会给你打电话。

phrases.en: Anna wants to know if you are free tomorrow.
phrases.zh: 安娜想知道你明天有没有空。

phrases.en: She wants to know when the train leaves.
phrases.zh: 她想知道火车什么时候出发。

phrases.en: Ben wants to know why you called him.
phrases.zh: 本想知道你为什么给他打电话。

phrases.en: We were invited to a party last week.
phrases.zh: 我们上周受邀参加了一场聚会。

phrases.en: We were met at the station by our friend.
phrases.zh: 我们的朋友在车站接了我们。

phrases.en: Dinner was served at seven.
phrases.zh: 晚餐七点上桌。

phrases.en: A new school has been built in our town.
phrases.zh: 我们镇上已经建成了一所新学校。

phrases.en: The old bridge hasn't been repaired yet.
phrases.zh: 那座旧桥还没有修好。

phrases.en: The road will be widened next year.
phrases.zh: 这条路明年将被拓宽。

phrases.en: The people behind me talked during the film.
phrases.zh: 我后面的人看电影时一直说话。

phrases.en: I couldn't hear the actors.
phrases.zh: 我听不清演员的声音。

phrases.en: Could you speak more quietly, please?
phrases.zh: 请你说话轻一点，好吗？

phrases.en: I usually get up at seven.
phrases.zh: 我通常七点起床。

phrases.en: Today I am having breakfast at ten.
phrases.zh: 今天我十点才在吃早饭。

phrases.en: What a lazy morning!
phrases.zh: 多么悠闲的早晨啊！

phrases.en: I visited a small town last summer.
phrases.zh: 我去年夏天去了一个小镇。

phrases.en: I bought my sister a postcard.
phrases.zh: 我给妹妹买了一张明信片。

phrases.en: I sent it to her the next day.
phrases.zh: 我第二天把它寄给了她。

phrases.en: My cousin Anna has arrived in London.
phrases.zh: 我的表妹安娜已经到伦敦了。

phrases.en: She has visited two museums.
phrases.zh: 她已经参观了两座博物馆。

phrases.en: She hasn't seen the river yet.
phrases.zh: 她还没有去看那条河。

phrases.en: I sent my uncle a letter last month.
phrases.zh: 我上个月给叔叔寄了一封信。

phrases.en: We have exchanged several messages this week.
phrases.zh: 我们这周已经互发了几条消息。

phrases.en: He has used email for many years.
phrases.zh: 他使用电子邮件很多年了。

phrases.en: I met a traveller at the station.
phrases.zh: 我在车站遇到一位旅行者。

phrases.en: The traveller asked me for directions.
phrases.zh: 那位旅行者向我问路。

phrases.en: I gave him some water and a map.
phrases.zh: 我给了他一些水和一张地图。

phrases.en: I was waiting outside when the lights went out.
phrases.zh: 停电时，我正在外面等候。

phrases.en: My friends were still eating inside.
phrases.zh: 我的朋友们还在里面吃饭。

phrases.en: We thought that the power would come back soon.
phrases.zh: 我们以为很快就会恢复供电。

phrases.en: This park is quieter than the one near my home.
phrases.zh: 这座公园比我家附近的那座安静。

phrases.en: The gardeners work very carefully.
phrases.zh: 园丁们工作非常细致。

phrases.en: It is the most beautiful park in our town.
phrases.zh: 它是我们镇上最美的公园。

phrases.en: Let's meet at eleven on Saturday night.
phrases.zh: 我们星期六晚上十一点见吧。

phrases.en: The celebration starts at midnight.
phrases.zh: 庆祝活动午夜开始。

phrases.en: In the end, our clock was five minutes slow.
phrases.zh: 最后发现我们的钟慢了五分钟。

phrases.en: This wooden box was made by my grandfather.
phrases.zh: 这个木盒子是我爷爷做的。

phrases.en: It was damaged during the move.
phrases.zh: 它搬家时被弄坏了。

phrases.en: It is kept on a shelf now.
phrases.zh: 它现在放在一个架子上。

phrases.en: My old friend works at a local bank.
phrases.zh: 我的老朋友在当地一家银行工作。

phrases.en: He was having lunch when I arrived.
phrases.zh: 我到的时候，他正在吃午饭。

phrases.en: He lent me some money, and I paid him back yesterday.
phrases.zh: 他借给我一些钱，我昨天还给了他。

phrases.en: I will leave for Shanghai tomorrow morning.
phrases.zh: 我明天早上将出发去上海。

phrases.en: My friends will see me off at the station.
phrases.zh: 我的朋友们将到车站为我送行。

phrases.en: I will stay there for three days.
phrases.zh: 我将在那里待三天。

phrases.en: At ten tomorrow, we will be waiting at the airport.
phrases.zh: 明天十点，我们将在机场等候。

phrases.en: The visitors will be staying at our hotel.
phrases.zh: 来访者将在我们的酒店入住。

phrases.en: Will you be joining us for dinner?
phrases.zh: 你会和我们一起吃晚饭吗？

phrases.en: I had learnt a few phrases before I travelled abroad.
phrases.zh: 出国旅行前，我学了几个表达。

phrases.en: The shopkeeper had never heard my accent before.
phrases.zh: 那位店主以前从没听过我的口音。

phrases.en: We understood each other after I showed him a picture.
phrases.zh: 我给他看了一张图片后，我们明白了彼此的意思。

phrases.en: My manager said that she was pleased with my work.
phrases.zh: 我的经理说她对我的工作很满意。

phrases.en: She told me that I would lead the next project.
phrases.zh: 她告诉我，我将负责下一个项目。

phrases.en: I told my family that I had received good news.
phrases.zh: 我告诉家人，我收到了一个好消息。

phrases.en: If you park here, you will block the entrance.
phrases.zh: 如果你把车停在这里，就会挡住入口。

phrases.en: The guard will ask you to move if you leave the car here.
phrases.zh: 如果你把车留在这里，保安会让你挪车。

phrases.en: If we use the car park, we won't cause a problem.
phrases.zh: 如果我们使用停车场，就不会造成麻烦。

phrases.en: I must finish this report today.
phrases.zh: 我今天必须完成这份报告。

phrases.en: We have to show our tickets at the entrance.
phrases.zh: 我们得在入口出示票。

phrases.en: I had to wait outside because I forgot mine.
phrases.zh: 我忘带自己的票，只好在外面等。

phrases.en: I had my bag with me when I entered the café.
phrases.zh: 进咖啡馆时，我带着自己的包。

phrases.en: I had a cup of tea and then left.
phrases.zh: 我喝了一杯茶就离开了。

phrases.en: When I reached home, I discovered that my bag was missing.
phrases.zh: 到家后，我发现包不见了。

phrases.en: May I have two tickets for tonight's show?
phrases.zh: 我可以买两张今晚演出的票吗？

phrases.en: Can you check whether there are any seats left?
phrases.zh: 你能查一下是否还有座位吗？

phrases.en: We may come tomorrow if tonight is fully booked.
phrases.zh: 如果今晚已订满，我们可能明天来。

phrases.en: Fishing helps me relax after work.
phrases.zh: 钓鱼能让我在下班后放松。

phrases.en: I enjoy sitting beside the river.
phrases.zh: 我喜欢坐在河边。

phrases.en: I am interested in learning more about local fish.
phrases.zh: 我有兴趣多了解当地的鱼。

phrases.en: Our street is cleaned every morning.
phrases.zh: 我们这条街每天早上都会被清扫。

phrases.en: The broken windows have been replaced.
phrases.zh: 破窗户已经更换了。

phrases.en: More trees should be planted near the road.
phrases.zh: 道路旁应该种更多的树。

phrases.en: I met my pen friend online two years ago.
phrases.zh: 我两年前在网上认识了我的笔友。

phrases.en: We now exchange messages much more often.
phrases.zh: 我们现在互发消息的频率高多了。

phrases.en: Talking face to face is far easier than writing long letters.
phrases.zh: 面对面聊天比写长信容易得多。

phrases.en: There are two bedrooms in our new flat.
phrases.zh: 我们的新公寓有两间卧室。

phrases.en: The walls were painted before we moved in.
phrases.zh: 我们搬进去前，墙壁就粉刷好了。

phrases.en: I told my friends that we would invite them for dinner.
phrases.zh: 我告诉朋友们，我们会请他们来吃晚饭。

phrases.en: I couldn't find my wallet after lunch.
phrases.zh: 午饭后，我找不到钱包了。

phrases.en: I asked the waiter to help me look for it.
phrases.zh: 我请服务员帮我找。

phrases.en: We found it under the chair where I had been sitting.
phrases.zh: 我们在我坐过的椅子下面找到了它。

phrases.en: I understood the words, but I missed the meaning.
phrases.zh: 我听懂了单词，却没明白意思。

phrases.en: Could you speak more slowly and use a shorter sentence?
phrases.zh: 你能说慢一点，用短一点的句子吗？

phrases.en: She not only repeated the sentence but showed me a picture as well.
phrases.zh: 她不仅重复了句子，还给我看了一张图片。

phrases.en: I think that the colours in this painting are beautiful.
phrases.zh: 我觉得这幅画的颜色很美。

phrases.en: My sister asked whether I liked the strange shapes.
phrases.zh: 我姐姐问我是否喜欢那些奇怪的形状。

phrases.en: She explained why the artist had used them.
phrases.zh: 她解释了画家为什么使用那些形状。

phrases.en: We put up our tent beside a lake.
phrases.zh: 我们在湖边搭起了帐篷。

phrases.en: After dinner, the wind became much stronger.
phrases.zh: 晚饭后，风变大了很多。

phrases.en: It rained all night, so we went home early the next morning.
phrases.zh: 雨下了一夜，所以我们第二天一早就回家了。

phrases.en: The neighbour who lives upstairs plays music at night.
phrases.zh: 住在楼上的邻居晚上放音乐。

phrases.en: I have asked him to turn it down.
phrases.zh: 我已经请他把音量调低了。

phrases.en: He says that he will use headphones from now on.
phrases.zh: 他说他以后会使用耳机。

phrases.en: Our town has started a small boat service.
phrases.zh: 我们镇上已经开通了一条小型客船航线。

phrases.en: It has carried visitors across the lake all summer.
phrases.zh: 整个夏天，它已经载着游客往返于湖两岸。

phrases.en: The best thing is that the trip takes only ten minutes.
phrases.zh: 最好的一点是航程只需要十分钟。

phrases.en: A child dropped a ball during the concert.
phrases.zh: 音乐会期间，一个孩子掉了一个球。

phrases.en: The ball rolled onto the stage.
phrases.zh: 那个球滚到了舞台上。

phrases.en: The singer picked it up and gave it back to the child.
phrases.zh: 歌手把球捡起来，还给了那个孩子。

phrases.en: My aunt started her business when she was twenty-five.
phrases.zh: 我姑姑二十五岁时开始创业。

phrases.en: At first, she was selling cakes from her kitchen.
phrases.zh: 起初，她在自家厨房制作蛋糕出售。

phrases.en: A few years later, she opened her own shop.
phrases.zh: 几年后，她开了自己的店。

phrases.en: This bag is as strong as the more expensive one.
phrases.zh: 这个包和更贵的那个一样结实。

phrases.en: Shopping online is not always as convenient as going to a shop.
phrases.zh: 网购并不总是和去商店一样方便。

phrases.en: I saw a man leave without paying for his coat.
phrases.zh: 我看见一个人没付外套的钱就离开了。

phrases.en: We walked across the field and through the trees.
phrases.zh: 我们走过田野，穿过树林。

phrases.en: When we got lost, we followed the river towards the village.
phrases.zh: 迷路后，我们沿着河朝村庄走去。

phrases.en: A guide came down the path and led us back to the road.
phrases.zh: 一位向导沿小路走来，带我们回到了公路。

phrases.en: My missing bike has been found.
phrases.zh: 我丢失的自行车已经找到了。

phrases.en: It was taken from outside my house last month.
phrases.zh: 上个月，它在我家门外被人拿走了。

phrases.en: It was returned to me by a local police officer.
phrases.zh: 当地一位警员把它归还给了我。

phrases.en: I saw a car hit the wall outside the shop.
phrases.zh: 我看见一辆车撞上了商店外的墙。

phrases.en: The driver was talking to someone when I arrived.
phrases.zh: 我到的时候，司机正在和别人说话。

phrases.en: I later learnt that nobody had been hurt.
phrases.zh: 我后来得知没有人受伤。

phrases.en: I am going to cycle across the county next month.
phrases.zh: 我准备下个月骑车穿过这个县。

phrases.en: I am meeting my coach on Friday to discuss the route.
phrases.zh: 我星期五要见教练，商量路线。

phrases.en: I think the hardest part will be the long climb.
phrases.zh: 我觉得最难的部分将是那段长坡。

phrases.en: By Friday, we will have prepared all the invitations.
phrases.zh: 到星期五，我们将准备好所有请柬。

phrases.en: The new hall will be opened next week.
phrases.zh: 新大厅将在下周开放。

phrases.en: At this time tomorrow, the team will be decorating it.
phrases.zh: 明天这个时候，团队将正在装饰它。

phrases.en: I had hoped to spend the whole day at the beach.
phrases.zh: 我原本希望在海边待一整天。

phrases.en: We had checked the weather before we left.
phrases.zh: 出发前，我们查过天气。

phrases.en: It started raining as soon as we arrived.
phrases.zh: 我们一到就开始下雨了。

phrases.en: The caller asked whether the manager was available.
phrases.zh: 来电者问经理是否有空接电话。

phrases.en: She asked when he would return.
phrases.zh: 她问他什么时候回来。

phrases.en: I told her that he would call her after lunch.
phrases.zh: 我告诉她，他午饭后会给她回电话。

phrases.en: If I had a larger kitchen, I would cook more often.
phrases.zh: 如果我的厨房更大，我就会更经常做饭。

phrases.en: If we lived nearer the station, we could walk there.
phrases.zh: 如果我们住得离车站更近，就可以走过去。

phrases.en: What would you change if you had more time?
phrases.zh: 如果你有更多时间，你会改变什么？

phrases.en: We need to buy some vegetables for dinner.
phrases.zh: 我们需要买些蔬菜做晚饭。

phrases.en: We don't need another bottle of oil.
phrases.zh: 我们不用再买一瓶油。

phrases.en: You needn't carry all the bags yourself.
phrases.zh: 你不用自己提所有的袋子。

phrases.en: We had a short break near the square.
phrases.zh: 我们在广场附近短暂休息了一会儿。

phrases.en: A musician was having trouble with his guitar.
phrases.zh: 一位音乐人的吉他出了问题。

phrases.en: After he fixed it, we had a wonderful time listening to him.
phrases.zh: 他修好吉他后，我们听他演奏，度过了愉快的时光。

phrases.en: I can swim, but the current was too strong.
phrases.zh: 我会游泳，但当时水流太急。

phrases.en: We were able to reach the bank with the guide's help.
phrases.zh: 在向导帮助下，我们成功到达了岸边。

phrases.en: What saved us was the rope he threw into the water.
phrases.zh: 救了我们的是他扔进水里的那根绳子。

phrases.en: Walking on the icy path was dangerous.
phrases.zh: 在结冰的小路上行走很危险。

phrases.en: We decided against continuing in the dark.
phrases.zh: 我们决定不在黑暗中继续前进。

phrases.en: By turning back early, we avoided getting lost.
phrases.zh: 我们及早折返，避免了迷路。

phrases.en: My wallet has been returned with all the money inside.
phrases.zh: 我的钱包已被归还，里面的钱一分没少。

phrases.en: It was left on the café counter yesterday.
phrases.zh: 昨天它被留在咖啡馆的柜台上。

phrases.en: It may have been found by the cleaner.
phrases.zh: 它可能是清洁工发现的。

phrases.en: We were surprised by the fact that the box was empty.
phrases.zh: 盒子是空的这一事实让我们很惊讶。

phrases.en: I could not explain why the lid had been opened.
phrases.zh: 我解释不了盖子为什么被打开了。

phrases.en: The damaged lock is being replaced now.
phrases.zh: 损坏的锁现在正在更换。

phrases.en: People say that strange sounds come from the old house.
phrases.zh: 人们说那座老房子里会传出奇怪的声音。

phrases.en: The neighbour who lives next door has heard them too.
phrases.zh: 住在隔壁的邻居也听到过。

phrases.en: They may be caused by loose pipes when the wind blows.
phrases.zh: 它们可能是刮风时松动的管道造成的。

phrases.en: I wanted to explain, but everyone was talking at once.
phrases.zh: 我想解释，但大家都同时在说话。

phrases.en: When the room became quiet, I showed them the correct date.
phrases.zh: 房间安静下来后，我给他们看了正确的日期。

phrases.en: Some had written down Monday; others, Tuesday.
phrases.zh: 一些人记的是星期一，另一些人记的是星期二。

phrases.en: When crossing the road, I noticed a loose wheel on the cart.
phrases.zh: 过马路时，我注意到手推车的一个轮子松了。

phrases.en: The wheel came off, so the boxes fell onto the pavement.
phrases.zh: 轮子掉了下来，所以箱子都掉到了人行道上。

phrases.en: Although shaken, the owner was able to collect them.
phrases.zh: 虽然吓了一跳，货主还是把箱子收拢了。

phrases.en: The bus going to the museum leaves from the next stop.
phrases.zh: 去博物馆的公交车从下一站出发。

phrases.en: Confused by the signs, I got on the wrong bus.
phrases.zh: 我被标识弄糊涂了，上错了公交车。

phrases.en: I got off at the next stop to ask for directions.
phrases.zh: 我在下一站下车问路。

phrases.en: I planned to save enough money for a new bicycle.
phrases.zh: 我原本计划攒够钱买一辆新自行车。

phrases.en: I bought snacks every day and spent more than I expected.
phrases.zh: 我每天买零食，花的钱比预想的多。

phrases.en: At the end of the month, I still did not have enough.
phrases.zh: 到了月底，我的钱仍然不够。

phrases.en: I have been painting the spare room all morning.
phrases.zh: 我整个上午都在粉刷空着的房间。

phrases.en: I have finished two walls so far.
phrases.zh: 目前我已经刷完了两面墙。

phrases.en: My sister has been helping me since nine.
phrases.zh: 我姐姐从九点起一直在帮我。

phrases.en: The power failed during the storm last night.
phrases.zh: 昨晚暴风雨期间停电了。

phrases.en: The engineers have found the damaged cable.
phrases.zh: 工程师们已经找到了损坏的电缆。

phrases.en: They have been repairing it since early morning.
phrases.zh: 他们从一大早起一直在抢修。

phrases.en: I was busy making dinner when the doorbell rang.
phrases.zh: 门铃响时，我正忙着做晚饭。

phrases.en: No sooner had I returned to the kitchen than the phone rang.
phrases.zh: 我刚回到厨房，电话就响了。

phrases.en: It took me an extra hour to finish cooking.
phrases.zh: 我多花了一个小时才做好饭。

phrases.en: Hoping to find my old watch, I searched every drawer.
phrases.zh: 希望找到旧手表，我搜遍了每个抽屉。

phrases.en: The box hidden under the bed contained only letters.
phrases.zh: 藏在床下的盒子里只有信。

phrases.en: I finally found the watch lying behind a book.
phrases.zh: 我最后发现手表躺在一本书后面。

phrases.en: Of the three bikes, this one is the lightest.
phrases.zh: 三辆自行车中，这辆最轻。

phrases.en: The red one is slightly faster but much more expensive.
phrases.zh: 红色的稍快一些，却贵得多。

phrases.en: For a short daily journey, the cheaper bike is just as useful.
phrases.zh: 对于每天的短途出行，便宜的那辆同样实用。

phrases.en: The assistant looked at me without saying anything.
phrases.zh: 店员看着我，一句话也没说。

phrases.en: After I asked about the price, she became more helpful.
phrases.zh: 我问了价格之后，她变得更愿意帮忙了。

phrases.en: I would like to try the coat on before paying for it.
phrases.zh: 我想先试穿这件外套再付款。

phrases.en: The old road has been widened.
phrases.zh: 那条旧路已经拓宽了。

phrases.en: It is the extra traffic that makes the street noisier.
phrases.zh: 使街道变吵的是增加的车流。

phrases.en: Although journeys are quicker, more noise barriers are needed.
phrases.zh: 虽然出行更快了，还是需要更多隔音设施。

phrases.en: We put up a fence to keep the dog out of the garden.
phrases.zh: 我们立了围栏，防止狗进入花园。

phrases.en: I moved the flowerpots so that they would get more sunlight.
phrases.zh: 我移动了花盆，让它们能得到更多阳光。

phrases.en: In order to save water, we collected rainwater in a barrel.
phrases.zh: 为了节约用水，我们用桶收集雨水。

phrases.en: I am meeting the organiser on Thursday.
phrases.zh: 我星期四要见组织者。

phrases.en: We are going to choose the final route then.
phrases.zh: 我们准备到时选定最终路线。

phrases.en: I think the event will attract many visitors.
phrases.zh: 我觉得这次活动会吸引很多游客。

phrases.en: This time next month, we will be testing the new bridge.
phrases.zh: 下个月这个时候，我们将正在检测新桥。

phrases.en: By December, the team will have completed the main structure.
phrases.zh: 到十二月，团队将完成主体结构。

phrases.en: By then, they will have been working on it for two years.
phrases.zh: 到那时，他们将已经为此工作了两年。

phrases.en: We had been walking for three hours when we reached the lake.
phrases.zh: 到达湖边时，我们已经走了三个小时。

phrases.en: The rain had stopped before we arrived.
phrases.zh: 我们到达前，雨已经停了。

phrases.en: Our guide had already prepared a place for us to rest.
phrases.zh: 向导已经为我们准备好了休息的地方。

phrases.en: My friend said that he had understood the joke.
phrases.zh: 我的朋友说他听懂了那个笑话。

phrases.en: The words that made me laugh confused him.
phrases.zh: 那些让我发笑的话却让他感到困惑。

phrases.en: He repeated the story as I had told it, but missed the final line.
phrases.zh: 他按我的讲法复述故事，却漏掉了最后一句。

phrases.en: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the last bus.
phrases.zh: 如果我们早点出发，就能赶上末班车了。

phrases.en: We could have visited the castle if it had been open.
phrases.zh: 如果城堡当时开放，我们就能参观了。

phrases.en: I wish I had checked the opening times.
phrases.zh: 我真希望自己当时查过开放时间。

phrases.en: We had to turn back because the bridge was unsafe.
phrases.zh: 因为桥不安全，我们不得不折返。

phrases.en: Trying to cross it would have been a mistake.
phrases.zh: 试着通过那座桥会是个错误。

phrases.en: We must find another route before setting off again.
phrases.zh: 再次出发前，我们必须找到另一条路线。

phrases.en: I would like to have this watch repaired.
phrases.zh: 我想请人修一下这块手表。

phrases.en: Can I have the strap replaced as well?
phrases.zh: 我能把表带也换了吗？

phrases.en: I had the battery changed last week, but it still stops.
phrases.zh: 我上周让人换了电池，但它还是会停。

phrases.en: We could see the entrance, but we couldn't reach it.
phrases.zh: 我们能看见入口，却到不了那里。

phrases.en: After moving the fallen branch, we were able to get through.
phrases.zh: 移开倒下的树枝后，我们成功通过了。

phrases.en: We finally managed to reach the cave before dark.
phrases.zh: 我们最终设法在天黑前到达了洞穴。

phrases.en: Thank you for inviting me, but I must leave now.
phrases.zh: 谢谢你的邀请，不过我现在得走了。

phrases.en: I don't want to keep my family waiting.
phrases.zh: 我不想让家人一直等我。

phrases.en: Would you mind meeting another day?
phrases.zh: 你介意改天再见吗？

phrases.en: Having been shown the controls, I started the machine.
phrases.zh: 别人教我操作按钮后，我启动了机器。

phrases.en: The red button was pressed by mistake.
phrases.zh: 红色按钮被误按了。

phrases.en: The machine had to be stopped before it could be checked.
phrases.zh: 机器必须先停下来，才能进行检查。

phrases.en: I was nervous about speaking in front of the crowd.
phrases.zh: 我对当众发言感到紧张。

phrases.en: The children were unaware of the danger near the water.
phrases.zh: 孩子们没有意识到水边的危险。

phrases.en: The organiser was pleased with the way we handled the problem.
phrases.zh: 组织者对我们处理问题的方式很满意。

phrases.en: The tower, which was built a century ago, still works.
phrases.zh: 那座塔建于一个世纪前，现在仍在运转。

phrases.en: The town had the clock repaired last winter.
phrases.zh: 去年冬天，镇上请人修好了那座钟。

phrases.en: If the repairs had been delayed, the clock would have stopped again.
phrases.zh: 如果维修当时被推迟，那座钟就会再次停摆。

phrases.en: After preparing for months, I tried to break my cycling record.
phrases.zh: 准备了几个月后，我尝试打破自己的骑行纪录。

phrases.en: A wrong turn cost me several minutes.
phrases.zh: 一次转错路让我损失了几分钟。

phrases.en: The route that I had chosen was shorter but harder to follow.
phrases.zh: 我选的路线更短，却更难辨认。

phrases.en: We left the coast at dawn and reached the hills by noon.
phrases.zh: 我们黎明离开海岸，中午前到达了山区。

phrases.en: Although the road was closed, we found a way through a village.
phrases.zh: 虽然道路封闭了，我们还是找到了穿过村庄的路线。

phrases.en: By the time we reached the final stop, we had crossed three counties.
phrases.zh: 到达最后一站时，我们已经穿过了三个县。

phrases.en: My neighbour usually wears a suit to work.
phrases.zh: 我的邻居通常穿西装上班。

phrases.en: Today he is wearing an old coat and carrying paint.
phrases.zh: 今天他穿着旧外套，提着油漆。

phrases.en: He is helping to decorate the hall, so people think he is a painter.
phrases.zh: 他正在帮忙装饰大厅，所以人们以为他是油漆工。

phrases.en: We lost the path near the northern side of the lake.
phrases.zh: 我们在湖的北侧附近找不到路了。

phrases.en: I sent our location and told the guide that there were three of us.
phrases.zh: 我发出了位置，并告诉向导我们有三个人。

phrases.en: He reached us before sunset and led us back to the village.
phrases.zh: 他日落前找到了我们，带我们回到了村庄。

phrases.en: A funny story has spread through our group today.
phrases.zh: 今天一个有趣的故事在我们的群里传开了。

phrases.en: People have been sharing it since breakfast.
phrases.zh: 从早饭时起，人们一直在转发它。

phrases.en: I have told everyone that it was only a joke.
phrases.zh: 我已经告诉大家，那只是个玩笑。

phrases.en: I lost this necklace when I moved house years ago.
phrases.zh: 我多年前搬家时丢了这条项链。

phrases.en: I have been looking for it ever since.
phrases.zh: 从那以后，我一直在找它。

phrases.en: My sister has finally found it inside an old box.
phrases.zh: 我姐姐终于在一个旧盒子里找到了它。

phrases.en: I decided to leave my phone outside the bedroom.
phrases.zh: 我决定把手机放在卧室外面。

phrases.en: The first night was difficult, but I slept better.
phrases.zh: 第一晚很难适应，但我睡得更好了。

phrases.en: I still feel the urge to check it before bed.
phrases.zh: 我睡前仍然有查看手机的冲动。

phrases.en: I used to worry about flying in bad weather.
phrases.zh: 我以前总担心在坏天气里坐飞机。

phrases.en: I am used to waiting when flights are delayed.
phrases.zh: 现在我已经习惯了航班延误时等候。

phrases.en: Only after the storm had passed did our plane take off.
phrases.zh: 直到暴风雨过去后，我们的飞机才起飞。

phrases.en: The new hall is twice as large as the old one.
phrases.zh: 新大厅的面积是旧大厅的两倍。

phrases.en: It can hold more visitors and is easier to reach.
phrases.zh: 它能容纳更多游客，也更方便到达。

phrases.en: Of the three venues, it is the best place for our exhibition.
phrases.zh: 三个场馆中，它最适合举办我们的展览。

phrases.en: We followed the dog through the gate and across the yard.
phrases.zh: 我们跟着狗穿过大门，走过院子。

phrases.en: It ran into a shed behind the house.
phrases.zh: 它跑进了房子后面的棚子。

phrases.en: When it came out, it was carrying my missing glove.
phrases.zh: 它出来时叼着我丢失的手套。

phrases.en: A large animal was seen near the lake last night.
phrases.zh: 昨晚有人在湖边看到了一只大型动物。

phrases.en: Several photographs have been examined.
phrases.zh: 已经检查了几张照片。

phrases.en: It may have been mistaken for a bear, but we need more evidence.
phrases.zh: 它可能被误认成了熊，但我们需要更多证据。

phrases.en: He asked whether the meeting had been cancelled.
phrases.zh: 他问会议是否已经取消。

phrases.en: I said that it had been postponed, not cancelled.
phrases.zh: 我说会议是延期了，并没有取消。

phrases.en: He asked again because he wanted to be sure about the new date.
phrases.zh: 他又问了一遍，因为他想确认新的日期。

phrases.en: The buses will stop running after six tomorrow.
phrases.zh: 公交车明天六点以后将停运。

phrases.en: I am going to take an earlier train instead.
phrases.zh: 我准备改坐更早的一班火车。

phrases.en: The station will probably be crowded, so we should leave extra time.
phrases.zh: 车站可能会很拥挤，所以我们应该预留更多时间。

phrases.en: I will practise English for forty-five minutes six days a week.
phrases.zh: 我将每周六天、每天练习英语四十五分钟。

phrases.en: This time next year, I will be studying the second book.
phrases.zh: 明年这个时候，我将正在学习第二册。

phrases.en: By then, I will have been following this plan for a year.
phrases.zh: 到那时，我将已经按这个计划学习了一年。

phrases.en: The old heater had been making a strange noise for days.
phrases.zh: 那台旧取暖器此前已经发出奇怪的声音好几天了。

phrases.en: I had turned it off before the engineer arrived.
phrases.zh: 工程师到来前，我已经把它关了。

phrases.en: He found that a small part had come loose.
phrases.zh: 他发现一个小零件松脱了。

phrases.en: Ben said that he had left at six and that he had walked home.
phrases.zh: 本说他六点离开的，而且是走回家的。

phrases.en: The receipt shows that he was still at the café at half past six.
phrases.zh: 收据显示他六点半还在咖啡馆。

phrases.en: His account does not match the time recorded on the receipt.
phrases.zh: 他的陈述与收据上记录的时间不符。

phrases.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will move the activity indoors.
phrases.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就把活动移到室内。

phrases.en: If we had a larger shelter, we could stay outside.
phrases.zh: 如果我们有更大的遮雨棚，就能留在室外。

phrases.en: If we had checked the forecast earlier, we would have changed the route.
phrases.zh: 如果我们早些查看天气预报，就会调整路线了。

phrases.en: I said Tuesday, but I meant Thursday.
phrases.zh: 我说了星期二，但我的意思是星期四。

phrases.en: The guests who heard the first announcement may have written down the wrong day.
phrases.zh: 听到第一次通知的客人可能记错了日期。

phrases.en: Please check the updated message so that you arrive on the correct day.
phrases.zh: 请查看更新后的消息，确保在正确的日期到达。

phrases.en: It was surprising to find a purple vegetable at the market.
phrases.zh: 在市场上看到一种紫色蔬菜，很令人惊讶。

phrases.en: The farmer, who grew it nearby, explained how to cook it.
phrases.zh: 那位在附近种植这种蔬菜的农民解释了烹调方法。

phrases.en: We had some for supper and found that it tasted quite sweet.
phrases.zh: 我们晚饭吃了一些，发现味道挺甜。

phrases.en: Our team can repair simple faults, but this one was unusual.
phrases.zh: 我们的团队能修理简单故障，但这次的故障很特别。

phrases.en: We were not able to open the damaged panel at first.
phrases.zh: 起初我们没能打开损坏的面板。

phrases.en: After borrowing the right tool, we managed to replace the broken part.
phrases.zh: 借到合适的工具后，我们设法换掉了坏零件。

phrases.en: I regret making a joke before I knew the whole story.
phrases.zh: 我后悔在了解全部情况前开了玩笑。

phrases.en: Seeing my friend upset, I explained what I had meant.
phrases.zh: 看到朋友难过，我解释了自己原本的意思。

phrases.en: I don't think joking about that topic was a good idea.
phrases.zh: 我觉得拿那个话题开玩笑不是个好主意。

phrases.en: The sculpture was made in a workshop outside the city.
phrases.zh: 那座雕塑是在城外的一间工坊里制作的。

phrases.en: It has been transported to the square in three sections.
phrases.zh: 它已经分成三个部分运到了广场。

phrases.en: The final section will be installed next week.
phrases.zh: 最后一部分将在下周安装。

phrases.en: I am getting accustomed to speaking in front of a group.
phrases.zh: 我正逐渐习惯在一群人面前讲话。

phrases.en: I was so nervous at first that I forgot my opening sentence.
phrases.zh: 起初我紧张得忘了开场白。

phrases.en: Whether I can give a full talk without notes remains to be seen.
phrases.zh: 我能否不用笔记完成整段演讲，还有待观察。

phrases.en: In my story, a tiny robot hid inside a suitcase.
phrases.zh: 在我编的故事里，一个小机器人藏在行李箱中。

phrases.en: If the owner had opened it earlier, he would have discovered the robot.
phrases.zh: 如果主人早点打开行李箱，就会发现那个机器人了。

phrases.en: He got the lock repaired, only to find that the robot had escaped.
phrases.zh: 他请人修好了锁，却发现机器人已经逃走了。

phrases.en: The festival, which takes place in spring, brings families together.
phrases.zh: 这个在春天举行的节日让家人团聚。

phrases.en: Before the meal, dishes prepared by different family members are placed on the table.
phrases.zh: 用餐前，由不同家人准备的菜肴被摆到桌上。

phrases.en: We share stories because remembering our family history is part of the celebration.
phrases.zh: 我们分享故事，因为纪念家族历史是庆祝活动的一部分。

notes: 课号与语法目标来自本项目 planning/book1-lesson-map.json 和 planning/book2-lesson-map.json；对应用户提供的两册本地学习资料。
三句话为依据各课 focus 与 canDo 编写的原创迁移练习，使用常见交际表达；不是教材课文摘录，也不替代本课原音频。
第一册以奇数情境课和下一课句型操练为一组，共 72 组；第二册每课一组，共 96 组。中文为练习句的简明释义。
可以替换姓名、物品、地点和时间，保持本课句型；涉及经历、事件和预测的示例为语言练习场景，不代表真实事件或保证的学习结果。
